decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.1655. Series context: trend strength 0.9934 and seasonal strength 0.1042; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.368); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 30.354.
